test_input: Press SPACE to flip gravity when needed. Press R to restart after GAME OVER. Press ESCAPE to quit.
expected_win_output: No WIN condition in this game; runs end with GAME OVER when the player falls.
expected_lose_output:
The console will show lines such as:
FLIP GRAVITY
RESTART
QUIT
GAME OVER
(Score prints appear in the HUD; final "GAME OVER" is printed when the run ends.)
notes:
Controls (and exact console prints):
- SPACE: flips gravity (prints exactly 'FLIP GRAVITY')
- R: restarts the run (prints exactly 'RESTART')
- ESCAPE: quits the game (prints exactly 'QUIT')
- When the character falls off the platforms the game prints 'GAME OVER'.
Implementation files and responsibilities:
- game/main.tscn: the main scene (GameManager, Player, Platforms, HUD nodes).
- game/game_manager.gd: Game state ownership (playing/game_over), input bindings, scoring, restart, HUD updates, connects to Player signals and prints control events.
- game/player.gd: automatic rightward movement, gravity flip logic and smooth rotation, collision detection against Platform instances, emits 'passed_platform' and 'fell'.
- game/platform.gd: platform geometry, drawing, collision shape, 'scored' flag and helpers get_rect()/get_right_edge().
Known limitations and approximations:
- No audio is implemented, per plan.
- Platforms are static rectangular nodes drawn procedurally; collision is created with StaticBody2D/CollisionShape2D to match visuals.
- The game has no victory condition; play ends on falling (GAME OVER).
- Restart always resets gravity to 'down' and rotation to 0 degrees (consistent restart behavior).
- Sprite scaling assumes the provided 32x32 PNG; if texture fails to load the player still functions but appears invisible.
Test notes:
- The viewport is fixed at 800x600. The Score label is at top-left. The Game Over label appears at top area when run ends.
- All required input actions are added at runtime by GameManager._ready().
